facts.fact: TechnoMag reports that the National AI Strategy 2026-2030 sets up the National Digital Regulatory Committee, hosted in POTRAZ, as Zimbabwe's independent regulatory body for AI and emerging technologies, with a mandate to develop and enforce regulatory frameworks.

ZWE.note: Governance structure of the AI strategy only; no government body using an AI system is stated.
Sector working groups and projects such as AI diagnostics are listed as planned focus, none stated in service or under way.

facts.fact: TechnoMag reports the AI Strategy Implementation Office within the lead ICT ministry, with specialised units, is named to drive the flagship initiatives and monitoring of the National AI Strategy 2026-2030.

ZWE.note: Strategy described as newly launched by the minister; no cabinet approval stated, so no standing fact. The Mugove/Umgele fund is named with no amount.
No AI model, dataset or computing stated.
Nothing on local government office connection; district Community AI Councils are not connections.
The Mugove/Umgele co-investment fund is described with no amount and no signed deal.
Nothing on school internet or a compulsory subject.
No startup law or strategy; the AI innovation fund and regulatory sandbox are part of the AI strategy, not a startup measure with labelling or financing stated.
No hub, incubator or park stated.
